name: flaneur
description: Flâneur — niche London detours, sorted by distance. Single-file React PWA; the spot catalogue lives in data/spots.json and is built into index.html.

scripts.native:sync: npm run native:bundle && npx cap sync && npm run native:normalize
scripts.native:add:ios: npm run native:bundle && npx cap add ios && npm run native:normalize
scripts.native:add:android: npm run native:bundle && npx cap add android && npm run native:normalize
